algorithm: PPO, SAC, TD-MPC2, BC, Diffusion Policy, ACT, PerAct, RLPD, RFCL
hand: Allegro Hand (incl. touch-sensor variant), Inspire Hand, Ability Hand, TriFinger
arm: Franka Panda, UR5, XArm7 (teleop), Koch v1.1 (sim2real)
headline_metric: sim+render throughput (FPS) and GPU memory usage vs Isaac Lab
headline_value: up to 30,000+ FPS; at 128 parallel environments with cameras, ManiSkill3 uses 3.5GB GPU memory vs Isaac Lab's 14.1GB
human_data: none (motion-planning, RL, and teleop-generated demonstrations, not a human dataset)
paper_code_mismatch: The paper's dexterous-manipulation section (App. VII-H) is two paragraphs with no task list, reward, or success definition; all concrete reward/success details had to be read from code, and evaluate() success-predicate bodies were not captured by the code parser so dexterous success thresholds remain unverified.
note_gaps: Dexterous task success-predicate bodies, hand DoF/vendor specs, and the exact environment count behind the '30,000+ FPS' headline figure are not present in either parsed source.
contact_model: PhysX (via SAPIEN) rigid-body contacts on GPU; no statement of convex-vs-mesh contact generation or contact-point count in the note. AllegroHandRightTouch reads FSR contact impulse (`get_fsr_impulse`) for touch sensing (App. VII-H, code).
solver: PhysX (via SAPIEN), used as-is; no LCP/PGS/TGS/Newton solver-algorithm name given. Benchmark (cartpole) settings state 'Solver Position Iterations: 4 / Solver Velocity Iterations: 0' (App. XI-A), but per-task `_default_sim_config` values are not exported in the parsed source.
solver_iterations: 4 position / 0 velocity iterations (benchmarked cartpole configuration only, App. XI-A); per-task defaults not exported in the parsed source
throughput: Up to 30,000+ FPS (RGBD+segmentation) on a single RTX 4090 GPU, environment count for that headline figure not stated; at 128 parallel environments with cameras, ManiSkill3 uses 3.5GB GPU memory vs. Isaac Lab's 14.1GB (Sec. III-B); PPO uses up to 4096 parallel environments for state-based training and 256-1024 for RGB training (App. IX-A), all on RTX 4090 (App. XI-A benchmark hardware).
